events.verdict: Thompson (GSW) is in Davis' (LAL) path and absorbs the body contact when Davis loses control of the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: The ball stays inbounds as Davis (LAL) retrieves it in the corner.
Poole (GSW) extends his hand into Reaves' (LAL) body and affects his shot attempt.
Bradley (LAL) and Poole (GSW) briefly engage and separate after the pick.
Westbrook (LAL) makes marginal contact with Curry (GSW) as he cuts, which doesn't affect his FOM.
Reaves (LAL) legally contests Thompson's (GSW) jump shot attempt.  Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Davis (LAL) and Wiggins (GSW) engage and separate during the incoming pass in the post.
Wiggins (GSW) makes marginal contact with Davis (LAL) during the drive, which doesn't affect his ability to pass.
Davis (LAL) and Curry (GSW) both engage for a rebounding position and separate.
Curry (GSW) grabs Davis' (LAL) arm as Davis retrieves the rebound. The contact occurs prior to Davis' upward shooting motion.
Westbrook (LAL) extends his arm into Wiggins' (GSW) back, knocking him off his spot and affecting his ability to rebound.
Thompson (GSW) briefly grasps Westbrook's (LAL) arm as he simultaneously dislodges the ball during the rebound.
Westbrook (LAL) makes marginal contact with Wiggins' (GSW) hand as both players move toward the rebound.
Thompson (GSW) doesn't maintain a legal guarding position when he makes contact with Davis' (LAL) upper body and affects his put-back shot attempt.
After Porter Jr. (GSW) loses control of the ball, Westbrook (LAL) makes marginal contact with him.
After the ball is dislodged, Thompson (GSW) makes marginal contact with James (LAL) on the rebound.
James (LAL) delivers contact by reaching across Wiggins' (GSW) front, affecting his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Porter Jr. (GSW) establishes himself in a legal screening position in Reaves' (LAL) path and absorbs the body contact during the pick.
Curry (GSW) does not bring two hands to the ball during his hesitation on the perimeter.
Reaves (LAL) moves legally alongside Curry's (GSW) path with a bent forearm when he contests the driving shot attempt.
Porter Jr. (GSW) brushes James' (LAL) arm, which doesn't affect his ability to pass.
Wiggins (GSW) dislodges the ball as incidental body contact occurs with Davis (LAL).
Looney (GSW) is moving his leg when it makes contact with the ball.
Looney (GSW) maintains vertical arms as he contests James' (LAL) shot attempt, and incidental contact occurs.
Westbrook (LAL) cleanly dislodges the ball before incidental contact occurs with Porter Jr. (GSW) on the rebound.
Reaves (LAL) makes marginal contact with Porter Jr. (GSW), which doesn't affect his FOM as he sets the pick.
Looney (GSW) and Davis (LAL) engage and separate during the rebound.
Westbrook (LAL) is in Thompson's (GSW) path when marginal contact occurs during the off-ball screen.
James (LAL) splits his feet at the start of his dribble.
Curry (GSW) wraps his arms around James' (LAL) waist prior to his upward shooting motion on the perimeter. A personal foul should have been assessed.

Curry (GSW) is inside the three-point arc and Westbrook (LAL) and Wiggins (GSW) enter the lane during James' (LAL) release on the free throw attempt. A double lane violation should be assessed, which would result in a jump ball at halfcourt.
Westbrook (LAL) and Wiggins (GSW) both engage and separate during the rebound.
Looney (GSW) and Davis (LAL) both engage for a rebounding position on the opposite side of the basket during the rebound.
As Reaves (LAL) moves toward the rebound, marginal body contact occurs with Porter Jr. (GSW) near the basket.
